instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and rotate the image 90 degrees clockwise, then save it as 'character_rotated.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, rotating it 90 degrees clockwise (Image > Transform > Rotate 90° clockwise), and saving as character_rotated.png. Evaluator compares result with a 90-degree clockwise rotated version of the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts and verifies image rotation by comparing pixel data of result vs rotated original
Metric function properly handles rule-based expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('rotated_90_cw'))
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both rotation (90° clockwise) and saving (by reading the saved file)
Appropriate error handling for missing files and read failures
Uses numpy array comparison with tolerance (atol=5) to handle minor JPEG compression artifacts
Expected value is semantically correct (rotated_90_cw: true matches instruction requirement)
